Example: Options Profit calculation

Using these inputs:

  • Current stock price: $200
  • Strategy: Long call
  • Legs (premium per share; 1 contract = 100 shares): Buy Call 200 7.18 1
  • Stock price at expiration: $220

The calculator returns:

  • Profit / loss at $220.00: +$1,282 (at expiration)
  • Max profit: Unlimited
  • Max loss: −$718.00
  • Break-even: $207.18
  • Net debit paid: $718.00 (100 shares controlled)
